messages:
Priya (docs): Heads-up: I opened a refresh PR to align our rate-limit + quota examples with metering v2. Preview: https://github.com/redwood-inc/docs/pull/6120. Can people quick-check the HTTP JSON, the JS SDK snippet, and the grafana panel link?
Evan (eng): Looking. Please avoid the deprecated X-Usage-Plan header in canonical examples. Show the JSON metering object first and add a short note that SDKs set X-Redwood-Usage for you.
Priya (docs): Will swap order. Current HTTP sample is tiny and uses JSON body. I'll make the header example an explicit fallback only.
Lina (product): Also note the updated tier bands in the explanatory paragraph. Marketing changed Standard to 85k-620k yesterday. Add a parenthetical: (see pricing page for live bands).
Marco (devex): SDK snippet should use the published v3 call: metering.record({ customerId, items }). Keep it 2 lines so it's copy-paste friendly. Also prefer ISO timestamps in examples.
Priya (docs): Updated SDK to: ```js
await metering.record({ customerId: 'acct_900', items: [{ 'generation.tokens': 130000 }] })
``` and switched HTTP block to JSON with language marker.
Evan (eng): Payload looks good. Two small nits: remove trailing comma after customerId in the JSON sample, and use the new grafana panel URL: https://grafana.redwood/d/usage/overview?panelId=33.
Priya (docs): Fixed comma and swapped the grafana link. Added image alt text: "Usage panel showing daily tokens per tier".
Lina (product): Could we add a one-line migration note: "If you used X-Usage-Plan header, migrate to JSON metering or X-Redwood-Usage; token->tier math is unchanged." Short and clear.
Priya (docs): Added migration blurb and a tiny diff showing old vs new example.
translate-bot: l10n check queued for new strings.
Evan (eng): LGTM from Eng. Tiny suggestion: mark the HTTP example block as "json" for highlighting.
Priya (docs): Done. Planning to merge after preview build passes. Thanks for the quick reviews! :tada:
